findings.summary: The parent accepts the worker's success receipt without verifying that the file currently present at the accepted root-relative destination still has the receipt's device/inode/size/content digest. A post-worker replacement or mutation is therefore accepted as success.
findings.source_location: tools/frozen_baseline.py, _owned_publish_immutable result validation and parent-chain acceptance (approximately lines 4521-4550): receipt metadata/digest are compared to the request, parent device/inode are re-opened and compared, but the destination filename is neither opened nor statted/hashed on the parent side.

independent_reproduction.method: Used synthetic temporary root and payload b'good'; patched PrepareExecution.run to execute the real brokered worker, then overwrite root/report.bin with same-length b'evil' before returning to _owned_publish_immutable.
independent_reproduction.observed: _owned_publish_immutable returned a successful receipt whose SHA-256 matched b'good', while root/report.bin contained b'evil'; actual_content != requested payload.

findings.required_regression: After the worker returns, reopen the validated parent chain and destination using no-follow descriptor-relative operations; compare no-follow stat and opened-file identity (dev/inode/size/link count), bounded-read and hash exact bytes, and match all receipt fields before accepting. Add deterministic post-worker same-inode mutation and pathname replacement tests. State the remaining race window after the last check; do not claim permanent immutability against same-UID writers without an OS-enforced mechanism.

prior_nested_parent_review.disposition: The corrective implementation adds a recorded ancestor identity chain; rechecks before/after link and before worker receipt; parent reopens the current chain and compares its parent dev/inode; and failure cleanup removes only exact worker-created inode links. Independent targeted regression passed all directory/symlink boundary cases. The source documentation correctly disclaims portable atomic ancestry locking and swap/restore protection.
